chunks: And by this chain, said, 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The one who seeks the pleasure of the people with what Angers Allah (Mighty and Majestic), his praisers from the people would become his condemners'.
ai.seo_question: What happens to a person who pleases people by disobeying God?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni highlights the fragility of human praise by noting that those who compromise divine pleasure for social approval inevitably face the reversal of public opinion, as their initial admirers become their detractors. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on *ikhlas* (sincerity) and warns against the instability of relying on worldly validation over the eternal satisfaction of Allah. It serves as a practical reminder that true stability lies in aligning one’s actions with divine will rather than fluctuating human sentiments.
